resources.string: Hold the floating button, speak, let go. Your words are transcribed on the phone, offline, and typed into whatever text box you\'re using.

Pocket Dictate uses Accessibility only to type your words into the box you're in. Because it was installed from outside the Galaxy Store, Samsung blocks this at first.

1. Tap “Open Accessibility settings”, then Installed apps > Pocket Dictate, and try to turn it on. You'll see “Restricted setting”. Tap OK.
2. Come back here and tap “Open App info”.
3. Tap the three dots (⋮) at the top right, then “Allow restricted settings”. Confirm with your fingerprint or PIN.
4. Tap “Open Accessibility settings” again: Installed apps > Pocket Dictate > turn it on > Allow.
Battery: stop Samsung putting it to sleep

So the button doesn't disappear after a while:

1. Tap “Open Battery settings” (or go to Settings > Battery).
2. Tap “Background usage limits”.
3. Tap “Never sleeping apps”.
4. Tap the + (Add apps) at the top right, tick Pocket Dictate, then tap Add.

If the button opens the wrong page, go to Settings > Battery yourself.

Hold the button to record, let go to transcribe. Drag it quickly to move it. Colours: teal = ready, red = recording, amber = transcribing, grey = loading or no model.

The button appears when the keyboard comes up (when you tap into a text box) and hides when it goes away. If it would be behind the keyboard, it moves up just above it. Turn this off to keep the button on screen all the time. Needs Accessibility turned on.
Brings the button back after the phone restarts. Android sometimes won\'t allow this straight away; if so, you\'ll get a notification. Tap it to turn the button on.
Changes US spellings to Australian ones (color → colour, organize → organise, center → centre). “Program” stays as it is.
Turn this on if text goes in oddly in a particular app, such as formatting being lost in an email. It pastes instead of editing the text box directly.
One rule per line: US word > Australian word. A line starting with ! keeps that exact word unchanged (for example !Labor for the party name). Lines starting with # are notes.
Replace your list with the original one? Your changes will be lost.

No accounts, no analytics, no cloud. The internet is used only to download the model.

Types the words you dictate with Pocket Dictate into the text box you\'re using. It only looks for the focused text box when you finish dictating. Nothing is collected or sent anywhere.
